name: Rio Bonito Grill

reviews.text:
All you can eat Halal Brazilian steakhouse located in Astoria, Queens NY. For $35 per person, you have access to 4-5 cuts of grilled meat including steak, lamb and chicken along with a limited buffet bar that has salads, appetizers, and fried goods.

Pretty solid for the value, definitely not as extensive as some of the other traditional Brazilian steakhouses. Went on a Thursday evening and it was mostly empty. Service was fast and friendly.

Really appreciate the fact that they have made their entire menu Halal and no longer have any cross contamination.

Firstly, the place opens after 5pm and there are no reservations so anyone coming with a group has to account for that. When we visited, the place was not overcrowded (Thursday) so its worked out. The food is generally good but very inconsistent, even to the extent that same meat cut but offered at different time could go between great and not great. The salad bar was decent but what really worked was the servers were very pleasant and the desert was great. Would I be back? Perhaps as its worth at a one-time visit for halal brazillian bbq…

Rio Bonita in Astoria is a must-visit for halal food lovers! Their $35 buffet menu is an absolute steal, offering a wide variety of delicious, high-quality meats, including chicken wings, picanha, sirloin steak, and more—all cooked to perfection. There’s a salad bar with pasta and other items. The flavors were rich, and everything was juicy and well-seasoned.

The ambiance is warm and inviting, and the service is excellent—the staff is attentive and keeps the meats coming without long waits. They also have a Mocktail menu which was a fun touch and paired well with the meal.

Though we didn’t stay for dessert, the options looked tempting. Overall, it’s a fantastic spot for a great meal, whether you’re a steak lover or just looking for a unique dining experience. Will definitely be back!

Expectations were blown away at this establishment, me and my family had a great time. Price in my opinion is fantastic, Finally getting Halal all you can eat Brazilian! Staff was super friendly, and the meat was super tender. Especially the top sirloin, lamb & chicken wings. They said they only have about 8 different meats, but we felt like we had more which was great! 100% recommend visiting and I’ll be going again! Try to come an hour before your initial time because they don’t do reservations, the place is not super big but it’s a nice cozy environment!

This place is SUPER BUSY. You’re going to get what you pay for. Host was pretty unhelpful over the phone, when we got there she told us the wait time was 40 min and just left us to wait there literally covering the entrance. There is no place to wait but in front of all the people eating. I get that it’s busy but being nice goes a long way, it didn’t even seemed like she cared if we stayed or not.

Anyways we got seated like 10 min later which was nice. Waitress was pretty nice. The meat was not good in my opinion, they don’t really have too many options, a lot of it was VERY RARE which I get some people like but not everyone. The “Buffet” is tiny, only one rice option which was not very good.

Cleanliness: bathrooms we’re disgusting. Women at bathroom had random cups on the floor, one with water. So gross, one of the male staff came out of the women’s bathroom.

Would I go back? Never - I can find better options to eat for $35 at a much more friendly and clean establishment
